text: Alright folks, buckle up, because the top of the heap is tighter than a penalty kill in overtime, with Green Jackets, Hot Dog, and Mon-Q all still deadlocked at the summit, showing us all that Francis Barrière, La saucisse, and Torida Té are playing chess while the rest of us are playing checkers. The biggest mover this week is Mohamad Lasania’s Pastaboy, making a two-spot jump into a tie for 12th thanks to some serious goal-scoring prowess, leaving Mathieu st’s The best team to tumble down the standings, looking like they forgot to set their lines this week. We’ve got drama brewing all over, but keep an eye on Louis Do’s LMD and Justin Do’s JeE-DeY, separated by just one measly point, and I predict this coming week will see at least one of those Do brothers slide into a playoff spot, or completely implode trying.
